plugins.name: replo

Build or update storefront experiences with Replo Agent, publish when you’re ready, manage products and assets, connect custom domains, and schedule recurring work. Use it to launch a product page from catalog data, find the right campaign assets, inspect orders, diagnose an underperforming page, or turn analytics into an A/B test.

skills.name: apply-branding
skills.description: Use when applying a brand to a Replo site, page, or section, including requested colors, fonts, or logo. Preserve the requested surface and attributes.
headings: Applying a Brand to a Replo Site
Working on a Replo site from your own machine
Site-wide steps — edit the token layer
skills.description_zh: 将指定品牌的颜色、字体或标识应用到 Replo 站点、页面或区块，保留用户指定的作用范围与属性。

skills.name: building-replo-pages
skills.description: Use when creating, editing, extending, or restyling any page or section of a Replo site — landing pages, product and collection pages, layouts, styling, images, translations, or routing. Replo sites are Next.js App Router repos you clone and edit. Triggers: make me a page, create a landing page, build a product page, update the about page, add a section, restyle this, make this a component, translate my site. To deploy, use the publish skill.
headings: Working on a Replo site from your own machine
1) Raw colors in components (color belongs only in globals.css)
3) Un-themeable built-in palette classes (the check most agents miss)
4) Server/client boundary: no "use client" in a page or layout
6) Primary-fill buttons (Button defaults to the primary variant when none is passed)
7) Pointer cursor on buttons (Tailwind v4 dropped it from preflight; globals.css must restore it)
skills.description_zh: 克隆并编辑采用 Next.js App Router 的 Replo 站点代码，创建、修改、扩展或重新设计页面和区块，涵盖落地页、商品与集合页、布局、样式、图片、翻译和路由；部署使用发布技能。

skills.name: custom-domains
skills.description: Use when a user asks to connect, add, verify, check, or troubleshoot a custom domain, configure DNS records, set up a root/apex/naked domain, or set up a subdomain. Also use when DNS verification fails, a domain is stuck pending, the user needs to see what DNS records to configure for an existing domain, or a domain shows "refused to connect" or redirects unexpectedly. Triggers: "connect my domain", "add a custom domain", "set up example.com", "DNS records", "domain not working", "domain pending", "domain stale", "verify my domain", "activate domain", "what DNS records do I need", "domain stuck", "domain not verifying", "refused to connect", "www not working", "domain redirecting".
headings: Retrieving DNS Instructions for an Existing Domain
skills.description_zh: 连接、添加、验证或排查 Replo 自定义域名，配置根域或子域 DNS，诊断验证失败、待处理或过期状态、拒绝连接及异常跳转，并查询已有域名所需 DNS 记录。

skills.name: figma
skills.description: REQUIRED when the user wants to build, rebuild, recreate, replicate, or match a Figma design, frame, or page, or to correct the fonts, layout, spacing, or imagery of a page built from one. Triggers: a figma.com link, "from Figma", "this Figma file", "match the Figma". Also covers reading Figma files, nodes, components, and styles through the project's Figma connection.
headings: Building a Replo page from a Figma design
Decide the mode before touching the design
Lock the source before the first page write
Correcting a page built from Figma earlier
skills.description_zh: 通过项目的 Figma 连接读取文件、节点、组件和样式，按 Figma 设计构建或重建页面，并修正对应字体、布局、间距及图片，使页面与指定设计相符。

skills.name: local-development
skills.description: Use when cloning, pulling, pushing, or running a Replo site's code outside Replo — on a laptop, in CI, or from a coding agent — through git.replo.app or a site's clone_url. Also use when the user asks which branches Replo supports, whether Replo has pull requests or review, whether pushing to main deploys or publishes, why pushed changes did or did not go live, or how to keep unfinished local work from being published. Triggers: "clone my site", "work on my site locally", "replo-git", "git.replo.app", "push to main", "does pushing deploy", "branches", "pull request", "review before publishing", "local dev server".
skills.description_zh: 通过 git.replo.app 或站点 clone_url 在 Replo 外克隆、拉取、推送或运行站点代码，适用于本机、CI 或编码代理开发；解释分支、PR 与审阅支持、推送 main 是否发布，以及如何避免未完成工作上线。

skills.name: okendo
skills.description: REQUIRED before generating pages with Okendo review data. Contains mandatory data loading patterns — code generated without reading this skill will use incorrect architecture.
headings: Example: Star Rating Widget with Aggregate Data
skills.description_zh: 为使用 Okendo 评论数据的 Replo 页面提供数据加载模式；原说明要求生成页面前读取，以避免采用错误的架构。

skills.name: product-display
skills.description: REQUIRED when building any page or component that displays product data. Contains product display requirements, pricing guidelines, and description rendering rules. Applies to both Shopify and Replo products.
headings: Missing Product IDs or No Products
skills.description_zh: 为展示商品数据的页面或组件规定商品展示、定价及描述渲染规则，适用于 Shopify 与 Replo 商品；原说明要求构建前读取。

skills.name: publish
skills.description: REQUIRED when the user asks to publish, deploy, go live, push live, make changes live, or ship. You MUST load this skill before taking any publish action. The `publish_site` tool is the ONLY way to publish — never run build or deploy commands directly via bash. Triggers: "publish", "deploy", "go live", "make it live", "push live", "ship it", "publish the site", "deploy my changes", "publish all", "publish everything", "publish all my sites".
headings: One Site Per Publish Request (pipeline constraint)
skills.description_zh: 处理 Replo 站点发布、部署与上线；原说明规定先读取此技能，且仅通过 publish_site 工具发布，不能直接在 bash 运行构建或部署命令。

skills.name: querying-analytics
skills.description:
Guide for using the `query_replo_analytics` MCP tool to run ClickHouse SQL queries against Replo analytics data.
Reference when: the agent needs to query analytics data, understand page views, sessions, purchases, conversion rates, or build custom analytics queries.
Also load for pixel-related queries, e.g. when querying for specific meta ads/adsets, etc
headings: Resolve metric meaning before choosing SQL
Rollup-based queries (preferred for large date-range aggregates)
skills.description_zh: 使用 query_replo_analytics MCP 工具对 Replo 分析数据运行 ClickHouse SQL，查询浏览量、会话、购买和转化率或构建自定义分析；也涵盖像素、特定 Meta 广告及广告组查询。

skills.name: rebuy
skills.description: REQUIRED before generating pages with Rebuy product recommendation data. Contains mandatory data loading patterns — code generated without reading this skill will use incorrect architecture.
headings: Example: Recommendation Loader Wiring with Prefetch
skills.description_zh: 为使用 Rebuy 商品推荐数据的 Replo 页面提供数据加载模式；原说明要求生成页面前读取，以避免架构错误。

skills.name: replo-branding
skills.description: Use when creating or updating a Replo brand kit — extracting a brand from a website URL, handling a Figma URL as the brand source, and applying the brand — all by prompting a Replo session.
headings: Create a brand kit from a website URL
Create or update a brand without a URL
Figma URL as the brand source
skills.description_zh: 通过向 Replo 会话描述需求，创建或更新品牌套件，从网站或 Figma URL 提取品牌并应用品牌样式。

skills.name: replo
skills.description: Use whenever a request touches Replo through the Replo connector: ecommerce sites and pages, brand kits (Brand Studio), Insights analytics and reports, Replo-managed products and orders, media assets, integrations, custom domains, scheduled tasks, skills, or plans. Explains how a Replo project is structured, which connector tools read or write each part, and what can only be done by describing it to a Replo session. Triggers include "build me a landing page", "set up my brand", "how is my site performing", "publish my site", "connect my domain", "schedule a weekly report", "make me a store".
headings: What lives in a Replo project
Sessions are where the work happens
Tools read and write records; sessions do the work
skills.description_zh: 作为 Replo 连接器工作入口，解释项目结构、各部分的读写工具以及只能通过会话描述完成的操作，涵盖电商站点、品牌套件、分析报告、商品订单、媒体、集成、域名、定时任务、技能和计划。

skills.name: safari-rendering
skills.description: Use when a page looks correct in the editor/preview or on the user''s laptop but wrong somewhere else — especially "only on mobile", "only on my phone/iPhone/iPad", "only on the live page", "only after publishing", "broken in Safari", "fine in Chrome but not Safari", images that collapse/squish/stretch, sections shorter than expected, content overflowing, rounded corners not clipping, a sticky/fixed bottom bar or footer/checkout/CTA that is cut off or won''t stay pinned to the bottom on mobile, content hidden behind the toolbar or home indicator, sticky headers jumping, gradient text showing solid, autoplay video not playing on mobile, or animation flicker. These are almost always WebKit (Safari/iOS) rendering differences, not editor bugs. Load before diagnosing or "fixing" a difference that only appears on a real device or the published URL.
headings: Diagnose: confirm it is actually WebKit first
Applying fixes in a Replo Sites (Next.js) page
skills.description_zh: 诊断 Replo 页面在编辑器或 Chrome 正常、在移动端、Safari/iOS 或发布后异常的渲染差异，包括图片变形、区块高度、溢出、圆角裁切、固定底栏、工具栏遮挡、粘性页眉、渐变文字、自动播放及动画闪烁；重点检查 WebKit 差异。

skills.name: shopify

Contains mandatory data loading patterns — code generated without reading this skill will use incorrect architecture. Use when user asks about Shopify, Shop Pay, Shopify products, metafields or metaobjects, etc
headings: Reading the store's catalog and custom data
Getting full product details in conversation
Always read a value before rendering one
skills.description_zh: 提供 Replo 中 Shopify、Shop Pay、商品、metafield 和 metaobject 的数据加载模式；原说明要求使用 Shopify 工具或生成含商品数据页面前读取。

skills.name: site-metadata-conventions

Triggers include "update the OG image", "change the site title", "set the description", "fix the social preview", "hide from Google", "add a favicon".
skills.description_zh: 按 Replo 站点元数据约定修改标题、描述、OG 图片、社交预览、favicon 及 noindex 搜索可见性等站点设置。

Full Loyalty Landing Page with All Loaders
skills.description_zh: 为使用 Smile.io 数据的会员忠诚度落地页提供数据加载模式；原说明要求构建页面前读取，以避免架构错误。

skills.name: statsig
skills.description: REQUIRED before running a Statsig A/B experiment on a page. Contains the mandatory SSR cohorting pattern (stable-ID cookie + data loader) — code generated without reading this skill will flash the wrong variant, mis-bucket visitors, or fail to record results.
headings: Step 1: Mint the stable ID cookie in middleware
Step 2: Read the cookie and prefetch the assignment (Server Component)
Step 3: Render the assigned variant (Client Component)
Setup requirements (tell the user if missing)
skills.description_zh: 在 Replo 页面开展 Statsig A/B 实验前采用规定的服务端分组模式，结合稳定 ID cookie 与数据加载器，避免错误版本闪现、访客分组错误或实验结果未记录。

skills.name: tracking-scripts
skills.description: Use when the user asks to add, install, remove, or change an analytics or marketing tracking script, pixel, or tag — GA4 / Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager (GTM), Meta / Facebook pixel, TikTok, Pinterest, Reddit, Snapchat, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, Contentsquare, Triple Whale, Elevar, Segment, Northbeam, Converge, Cookiebot — or pastes a raw `<script>` tag and says "put this on my page", or mentions cookie consent, Cookiebot, a consent management platform (CMP), GDPR/CCPA compliance, customizing/restyling/replacing the cookie consent banner, or making a script respect consent at runtime (window.Replo.customerPrivacy / visitorConsentCollected).
headings: Raw scripts the user insists on pasting directly
Runtime consent API (for scripts that must self-gate)
skills.description_zh: 在 Replo 添加、安装、移除或修改分析与营销追踪脚本、像素和标签，涵盖 GA4、GTM、Meta 等平台；也处理 Cookiebot、同意管理平台、同意横幅样式及运行时尊重用户同意的脚本逻辑。
